title: Master of Law (General) (I) (LtCol to Maj) NMOS (4402), SJA to CMC
raw_text:
8. MOS 4410, Master of Law (General) (I) (LtCol to Maj) NMOS (4402), SJA to
CMC

    a. Summary. A Master of Law (General) has specialized education in a
variety of civilian and military law areas.

       b.   Prerequisites

        (1) Must hold a Master of Laws degree (LL.M.) from either the general
studies program or the specialty program in Administrative and Civil Law of
the Graduate Course (A060AB1) at The Judge Advocate General's Legal Center
and School, U.S. Army.

        (2) Must be in the rank of major or lieutenant colonel. Judge
advocates who obtain the necessary LL.M. as a captain will not receive the
additional MOS until promoted to the rank of major.

    c. Requirements. Judge Advocate Division, in conjunction with DC, M&RA
(MMOA), is responsible for assignment of this AMOS.

       d.   Duties

            (1) May serve in any other MOS 4402 billet.

            (2) Serve in a wide variety of legal billets throughout the Marine
Corps.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Lawyers 23-1011.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.
